core_obligations: Construct the projective completed-module complex on a finite clopen partition, including the original lifting and cone argument.
difficulty_reason: The author builds finite projective completed-module models for an adically constructible complex by induction on its amplitude, lifting the highest cohomology and controlling the cone on clopen pieces of a weakly contractible affine. The local lifting, completion and induction are included rather than replaced by an abstract constructibility assertion.
